quality_metrics.collected_by: United States Department of Agriculture| Agricultural Research Service WRRC

curation.notes: GenomeTrakr isolate ISO000124696 (SEQSEQ000126899). Strain RM10843. Isolation: feral pig from porcine (2009). Assembly not available - generate locally.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR23097950 && mv data/SRR23097950_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR23097950_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

assembly.notes: Assembly not available in NCBI. Generate locally: spades.py -1 data/reads_1.fq.gz -2 data/reads_2.fq.gz -o assembly/ --careful && cp assembly/contigs.fasta data/contigs.fa

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype O26:H11. Accept exact match 'O26:H11' or individual O/H antigen calls that match. Serotype confirmed in GenomeTrakr GIMS database (ISOISO000124696). Tool should confidently call this serotype.
validation_instructions.virulence: Expected STEC virulence genes: stx1, stx2, eae, ehxA. At minimum, stx (Shiga toxin) and eae (intimin) should be detected for typical STEC. Accept PASS if all expected genes found. PARTIAL if stx present but other genes missing.
validation_instructions.mlst: Run mlst with 'ecoli' scheme. ST will vary by isolate. Document observed ST for future reference.

notes: Non-O157 STEC, common in Europe, associated with cattle and leafy greens
